# Tracking data shows that two more Indian flagged LPG ships have left the Gulf.

Posted to Maritime Reporter on April 6, 2026

According to data from LSEG and Kpler, two more Indian flagged liquefied 'petroleum gas' tankers have left the Gulf with fuel for a South -Asian nation.

The data revealed that a third vessel, Jag Vikram is still west of the Strait of Hormuz. The U.S. and Israeli war?against Iran?has all but halted the shipping through the strait. Iran, however, says that "non-hostile vessel" can transit the waterway if it coordinates with Iranian authorities. [...] (source: Reuters)
